messages.subject: Default hex dimensions in stat_binhex
parts:
Hello ggplotters,

Is there a way to obtain the default hex dimensions from the stat_binhex statistical transformation?

I'm not sure how to pose the question.

In the following example the default bin size is 30.  But, what are the dimensions of the hex?  At the very least xlim and ylim of hex?

library(ggplot2)
d <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price)) 
d + stat_binhex() 
d + stat_binhex(bins = 30)

Thanks,
 Art
